title: spec-meta.json
description: Durable lifecycle record for one specification. This stage reads `issue` and writes `stage` and `spec_branch`.

issue.description: Lifecycle issue number. null only before this stage creates one for a hand-submitted spec (FR-007).

stage.description: This stage transitions spec -> plan on success, or plan -> stalled if the plan PR closes unmerged (FR-005, FR-012).

iteration.description: Implement/converge loop counter. Not modified by this stage.

spec_branch.description: Set by this stage the first time spec/NNN-slug is created or confirmed to exist (FR-002).

review_gate.description: specs/062-lifecycle-review-gate, data-model.md §1. null until lifecycle-review-gate.yml first evaluates this specification's lifecycle PR. Not modified by this (plan) stage.
